Class MenuImages

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.holograms.api.MenuImages
public final class MenuImages extends Object
A picture for a menu: each frame drawn on a square panel (a chequered background where it is see-through) and sent to one player's game as its own image, so an AssetImage shows it sharp, and an animation plays by giving the element the next frame's path. The game's own pages show pictures the same way (#Icon.AssetPath). 
List<String> frames = MenuImages.send(player, picture, TextImage.PictureFrame.NONE, "mypicture");
cmd.set("#Image.AssetPath", frames.get(0));   // AssetImage #Image { Anchor: (Width: 192, Height: 192); }
Sent once per key: a new key for a new picture. Since API_VERSION 5.

  • Method Details

    • send

      public static List<String> send(com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.universe.PlayerRef player, Picture picture, TextImage.PictureFrame frame, String key)
      Draws and sends the picture's frames to this player; returns one image path per frame of the picture (frames left out show the one before them). Slow for a big animation: call it off the world thread.
      Parameters:
      key - letters, digits, - and _ only; the same key replaces what was sent under it
